result.title: Latent Multimodal Memory Reasoning
result.summary: Long-term personalized agents are required to reason over distributed history across modalities and evolving dialogue states. While existing flat cross-modal methods compress visual evidence prematurely and struggle with temporally stale observations, they neglect the necessity to unify multimodal and cross-session evidence. Crucially, raw multimodal memories are inherently entangled and heterogeneous, making fine-grained visual grounding and cross-modal reasoning computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present latent multimodal memory reasoning, i.e., LMMR, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that shifts long-term multimodal memory organization into a continuous latent space. Specifically, (i) instead of converting images to text and relying on static retrieval, LMMR maps both textual hidden states and visual patch features into a shared Sparse Autoencoder concept space, establishing sparse activations as common semantic addresses to dynamically construct a turn-level multimodal memory graph. (ii) A graph encoder then aggregates cross-modal and temporal dependencies across the task-specific latent subgraph, injecting the graph readout as a continuous residual rollout into the generation backbone while retaining native visual tokens to preserve fine-grained details. Extensive experiments on nine Mem-Gallery tasks and twelve MemEye settings demonstrate that LMMR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in capturing complex multimodal dependencies while enabling faithful and grounded responses.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LMMR：将文本隐状态与视觉 patch 特征映射到共享的稀疏自编码器概念空间，以稀疏激活作为语义地址动态构建轮级多模态记忆图，图编码器聚合跨模态与时序依赖并以连续残差注入生成骨干，同时保留原始视觉 token，在 Mem-Gallery 与 MemEye 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及 latent 状态的表示与使用：概念空间和记忆图给出 latent 的构造与更新方式，连续残差注入可供核查 latent 内容是否真被答案使用，保留原生视觉 token 对应细节保留问题；其记忆组织与推理期视觉证据筛选、停止决策的边界待核查。
